claims.text: The FDA label says alcohol combined with perampanel significantly worsened mood and increased anger.
claims.quote: The combination of alcohol and perampanel significantly worsened mood and increased anger.

claims.text: The FDA label says concomitant alcohol and perampanel may increase CNS depression.
claims.quote: The concomitant use of perampanel and CNS depressants including alcohol may increase CNS depression.

claims.text: The EMA perampanel label reports additive or supra-additive effects with alcohol on alertness and vigilance tasks in healthy subjects.
claims.quote: The effects of perampanel on tasks involving alertness and vigilance such as driving ability were additive or supra-additive to the effects of alcohol itself, as found in a pharmacodynamic interaction study in healthy subjects.

headline.text: The FDA label says alcohol combined with perampanel significantly worsened mood and increased anger.

reported.text: The label reports worsened mood and increased anger with the combination.
